checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One square finished image is delivered.
must.why: A single 640x640 square image was delivered.

must.item: The headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.” including punctuation.
must.why: The image has no text at all.

must.item: The headline is clearly readable against the background and is not clipped.
must.why: There is no headline to read.

must.item: A steaming espresso sits on a sunlit café table.
must.why: The espresso is on a warm wooden café table, but no steam is visible. The drink looks more like a latte or cappuccino with milk foam than an espresso. The lighting is soft rather than clearly sunlit.
No text appears, so no extra text does either.

exact_text.read_as: No text visible in the image

faults.what: The required headline "Small cup. Big energy." is missing.
No steam is visible rising from the cup.
The drink has a white milk-foam pattern, so it looks like a macchiato or latte rather than a pure espresso with crema.
The image is only 640px, which is low resolution.

summary: The image is a clean, attractive square photo of a coffee cup on a wooden café table, but it has no headline text, no steam, and the drink looks more like a latte than an espresso.
